full_judgment: "There is no presumption that because the institution is a religious or charitable trust, all of its activities must be supposed to be for the carrying out of a religious or charitable purpose. The proviso is carefully worded to distinguish activities whose object is to implement or effectuate directly a religious or charitable purpose, from all other activities, and clearly the plying of launches by itself cannot be brought within any of the religious or charitable purposes which are specified in the Trust Deed."
